verdict.rationale: Any public web service could publish an llms.txt or agent-oriented docs, so this axis applies to ANEF. The evidence shows no such resource. The probes found only a ~3 KB JavaScript shell that yields under 200 characters of text, and a Cloudflare challenge on the parent ministry site, with no mention of llms.txt or agent documentation.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can point an agent at llms.txt or agent-oriented docs
